caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a slightly convex lid, primarily rendered in blue and tan-brown tones. The container has a horizontal tan band at the top edge, separating the lid from the body. The body and lid of the container are decorated with a detailed pastoral scene. On the side of the cylinder, the scene shows a group of two horses pulling a wagon loaded with objects and guided by a standing human figure. The human figure is positioned beside the horses, holding what appears to be a walking stick or whip. Around these central elements, there are several brown trees with white accents and scattered foliage, some of which extend onto the lid’s surface. There is also detailed grassy vegetation at the base. The entire illustration is set against a plain, beige background, with no additional contextual objects. The artist's signature, "Walter Doran," appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
